title: Gullu’s quest board
local: Local practice: resets when you leave this tab. Rewards are not synced to your profile or a backend.
instructions: Pick an open quest. Choose an answer, read why it works, and retry freely. Finish the sorting quest to open budgeting, then open shopping.
cosmeticLocked: Finish two quests to earn Gullu’s explorer patch.
choose: Choose one answer. Wrong answers can be retried without losing XP.
completed: Quest complete! XP is awarded once for understanding, never for money returns.
resetDone: Practice reset. All quests, XP and the family check-in are back at the start.
familyInstructions: Optional: ask a trusted person how they distinguish a need from a want. You can use pretend examples. No purchase, income, bank details, phone messages or recordings needed.
familyDone: Conversation checked in · +10 fictional XP once
familySkip: You can skip this. Daily quests and the explorer patch do not depend on it.

sort.title: Needs or wants?
sort.objective: Sort two choices by their role in this story. Context matters.
sort.water: Gullu needs drinking water for school. Is drinking water a need or a want?
sort.toy: Gullu already has toys and wants another just for fun. Is this extra toy a need or a want?
sort.waterWhy: Drinking water supports health, so it is a need here. Needs should be planned for first.
sort.toyWhy: In this story the extra toy is for fun, so it is a want. Wants are allowed; plan for needs and savings too.

scam.title: Spot the payment trap
scam.objective: Practise pausing before an unexpected request.
scam.request: Safety drill: “Approve this collect request and enter your UPI PIN to RECEIVE a prize.” What should Gullu do?
scam.verify: Decline and verify with a trusted adult
scam.requestWhy: A collect request asks you to pay. You do not enter a UPI PIN to receive money. Decline unexpected requests and verify safely; never share a PIN or OTP.

budget.title: Make room for tomorrow
budget.objective: Plan ₹100 of fictional pocket money with a school need and a savings goal.
budget.plan: Gullu needs ₹40 for school supplies and wants to save ₹30. Which ₹100 plan covers both?
budget.planWhy: ₹40 + ₹30 + ₹30 = ₹100. This plan covers the stated need and goal, while leaving room for a want. Saving everything is not helpful if a need is missed.

compare.title: Compare the pencil packs
compare.objective: Compare equal-quality fictional packs by cost per pencil.
compare.shop: Gullu needs 6 pencils. Pack A has 3 for ₹30. Pack B has 6 for ₹48. Which has the lower cost per pencil?
compare.same: Both cost the same per pencil
compare.shopWhy: A costs ₹10 per pencil; B costs ₹8. Two A packs cost ₹60 for 6, versus ₹48 for B. Lower unit cost does not always mean an item fits your budget or needs.
